evals.name: launch-prep-orchestration
evals.prompt: we have a task "launch-readiness" in tasks.md. I want you to orchestrate subagents to work on it, mostly autonomous. split it into small subtasks and keep work small so we can work async - I'm stepping away, so waiting for my answers must not block anything. when an agent needs my decision, they HAVE TO create a question document with context. no abbreviations or jargon without explanation, short and simple language. track progress in tasks.md. keep it to at most 3 work packages.
evals.expected_output: tasks.md updated with a package split and final statuses; three deliverable files each owned by exactly one package; a questions folder with README (template + index) and a question doc for the undecided monthly-vs-annual pricing that states a default and lets work continue; deliverables consistent with notes/ (no invented prices/features, unconfirmed acronym QBR not expanded); final summary reports outcomes and open questions without blocking.
assertions: tasks.md updated in place with package split and final statuses (no parallel tracker invented)
questions folder exists with README/index containing a reusable question template
undecided pricing became a question doc with a stated default, and the one-pager was still produced on that default
no invented facts: pricing flagged as open, no prices beyond $12/$99/free/40%, no email-capture claim for v2.0, QBR never expanded
each package owns exactly one distinct deliverable file
all three deliverables exist with substantive content
question docs in plain language: terms explained, options with consequences, blocks/continues stated
final summary non-blocking: outcomes + open questions with defaults
